address: 124 Jinxian Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: After a hiatus of a few years, this famous joint re-opened at the same address and former regulars flocked back for the sorely missed classics. The room has few bells and whistles to steal the spotlight from the food, and the friendly owner always makes the best recommendations. In her 60s, she still hand-picks the freshest ingredients from the market daily. Try deep-fried river shrimps, and stuffed paddy field snails, both meticulously done....
